title: Zilker, before and after the music
subtitle: Saturday brought a delay and a reminder of the restoration contract
source: KXAN · FOX 7 Austin · City of Austin
alt: Timeline of the 2026 Austin City Limits Music Festival at Zilker Park. The first weekend runs October 2 through 4. On October 3 the gates opened at 2 p.m. instead of noon because of wet grounds. The second weekend runs October 9 through 11. The Parks Department says the festival contract requires restoration of the Great Lawn and surrounding areas after the event, including replacement grass where needed; no reopening date is promised here.
